text: In filtered mode, deleteCookie walks selected ranges backwards, gathers each range before removing it, and updates filterSet plus the backing host cookie arrays. In unfiltered mode, deleting a host removes both _hosts key and _hostOrder entry. Native cookie removals happen after model changes. Preserve reverse range order and the separate backing collections when editing this route; an indexed loop expresses this mutation contract. No cookie deletion, selection or focus test ran.
title: Cookie selection deletion runs ranges backwards and updates both host collections
